name: Iron Man
summary: A weapons maker turned hero, built on a dare. Tony Stark, genius inventor and founding Avenger, fights in suits of powered armor that he never stops redesigning.
origin: Iron Man was Stan Lee daring Cold War readers to cheer for a weapons maker, and somehow it worked. Tony Stark debuted in Tales of Suspense #39 (on sale late 1962, cover-dated 1963), a genius industrialist captured in Vietnam with shrapnel creeping toward his heart, who builds a suit of armor to stay alive and break out. That first suit was clunky and grey; it turned gold one issue later, and the look has been upgraded constantly since. Tony became a founding Avenger alongside the Hulk, Thor, the Wasp and Ant-Man, and got his own series in 1968. Strip away the armor and he is still the smartest, most self-sabotaging guy in the room.
powers: Inventor and engineer of rare genius
Powered armor with flight, repulsors and sensors

storyline.title: Built in a cave
storyline.beat: Weapons maker Tony Stark is wounded and captured abroad. With fellow prisoner Ho Yinsen he builds a suit of armour to keep his heart going and escape. The first suit is grey, turns gold the next issue and later becomes red and gold.

storyline.title: Founding member
storyline.beat: Tony helps found the Avengers and, as their wealthy backer, gives the team its mansion and resources.

storyline.title: Facing addiction
storyline.beat: Writers David Michelinie and Bob Layton show Tony battling alcoholism, one of the first major superhero stories to deal with addiction.

storyline.title: War Machine's first run
storyline.beat: After Tony relapses, his friend Jim Rhodes wears the armour as Iron Man for a long stretch.

storyline.title: Stolen tech
storyline.beat: Tony learns his designs have been stolen and goes after everyone using them, heroes included.

storyline.title: Wired in
storyline.beat: Warren Ellis and Adi Granov give Tony a techno-virus that links his body to the armour, modernising the character.

storyline.title: Pro-registration
storyline.beat: Tony leads the heroes who back government registration, wins the conflict and becomes the director of S.H.I.E.L.D.

gossip.text: Iron Man was always one of Marvel's biggest stars.
gossip.truth: Before the 2008 film he was widely seen as a second-tier hero outside comics fandom. The movie changed that.

gossip.text: Stan Lee said he made Tony a weapons-making capitalist on purpose, to dare 1960s readers to like a character they should hate. Howard Hughes was part of the inspiration.
His very first armour was a clunky grey suit, painted gold the next issue.
His comic origin was set during the Vietnam War. The 2008 film moved it to Afghanistan.
Casting Robert Downey Jr. in 2008 was considered a big gamble. The film launched the whole Marvel Cinematic Universe.

quiz.q: What colour was Iron Man's first armour?
quiz.why: The first suit was grey and turned gold in the next issue.

quiz.q: What does Tony struggle with in Demon in a Bottle?
quiz.why: The 1979 story deals with his alcoholism.

quiz.q: Who helped Tony build his first armour?
quiz.why: Fellow prisoner Ho Yinsen helped him.

timeline.title: Built in a cave
timeline.note: Tales of Suspense #39 has weapons maker Tony Stark build a clunky gray armor to escape his captors.

timeline.title: Founding Avenger
timeline.note: The Avengers #1 makes Tony a founding member, and he funds the team for years after.

timeline.title: First cartoon armor
timeline.note: The Marvel Super Heroes cartoon gives Iron Man his own rotating segment.

timeline.title: Demon in a Bottle
timeline.note: Iron Man #128 caps a storyline about Tony's drinking, a rare frank look at addiction in mainstream comics.

timeline.title: Rhodey in the armor
timeline.note: Iron Man #170 has James Rhodes take over the suit while Tony struggles, years before War Machine.

timeline.title: Civil War
timeline.note: Tony leads the pro-registration side, putting him in a public brawl with Captain America.

timeline.title: Robert Downey Jr. launches the MCU
timeline.note: Iron Man kicks off the Marvel Cinematic Universe, with Downey's casting widely seen as a career comeback.

timeline.title: Riri Williams steps up
timeline.note: A teen genius named Riri Williams builds her own armor and later becomes Ironheart.
